text.printed:
Permanent. Victory 1.
When Revealed: Put the set-aside mini-boss minion into play engaged with you and attach this card to it. Shuffle the rest of the mini-boss modular set into the encounter deck.
Attached minion's printed hit points are 14. It gains villainous, guard, and the Influenced and Elite traits.
